name: @winche-technologies/winche-plugin-stripe
description: A Winche plugin: payments and subscriptions with Stripe. Checkout and the customer portal as callables, subscriptions kept on users (claims, a read-only record) from Stripe's webhooks.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/self-types.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && deno test --quiet --allow-env --config test/deno.json test/
